isolated_checkout.head: 2d3e8f397d57009ba843c83b2a75a176262b026c
isolated_checkout.mode_normalization_rule: Only shebang-bearing scripts are executable; content bytes and source/public SHA-256 values are unchanged.

process_and_container_check.limitation: Host process isolation prevents exhaustive file-descriptor inspection for other users; no global no-writer claim is made from /proc alone.

source_stability.stability_basis: Every selected source and public-copy hash matched the copy-time lineage index at the later recheck; the Git candidate is sealed separately and post-cutoff source changes are out of scope.

conclusion.reason: The fixed copied scope is byte-traceable at two checked times and no visible writer or campaign container was active; process-visibility and permissive source-mode limitations are disclosed.
